links.outcome: Compared three multimodal LLMs against each other on the same CT cases
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o accuracy 0.89, kappa 0.77; ChatGPT-5 accuracy 0.67, kappa 0.33; Gemini 2.5 Pro accuracy 0.56, kappa 0.11; ChatGPT-4o significantly better (p<0.001 each).
links.quote: Multimodal LLMs showed significant differences in CT-based polyp detection under the same inputs, depending on the version and vendor.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates and compares the diagnostic reliability of multiple commercial multimodal LLMs on retrospective CT slices, but does not test a specific operational safeguard or deployment practice.
